content:
[0] Meta has been busy launching new iPhone apps this summer, with the latest one called Facebook Creator Studio.

[1] Meta's new iPhone app is an "AI-powered daily companion" for Facebook creators

[2] Meta describes this brand-new iPhone app as an "AI-powered daily companion for Facebook creators."

[3] The introduction of Facebook Creator Studio is as follows:

[4] Meta stated that the new Facebook app aims to make it easier for users to explore various interests, providing more personalized News Feed, Marketplace, Reels, and search functions, with built-in access to Meta AI.

[5] The app also places greater emphasis on connecting users with friends, creators, and communities through Groups, friend controls, and private sharing of posts and Reels.

[6] The new app joins a series of recently launched new members, including Seller and StoryKit (the latter being a limited market test).

[7] Facebook Creator Studio for iPhone is now available on the App Store.

[8] Get the most out of your Apple products
